name: Gnomes Win!
summary: In Thousand Needles, the gnomes' victory decides which ticket pays out. The holder of the winning ticket gets a prize box.

sections.title: The Gnome Ticket
sections.body: When the gnomes win, the holder of the Gnome Race Ticket gets the prize box. The goblin ticket counts for the other side of the race.

faq.q: What is the Gnome Race Ticket?
faq.answer: The Gnome Race Ticket backs the gnome side of the race in Thousand Needles. It matters when the gnomes win.

faq.q: What do you get when the gnomes win?
faq.answer: Whoever holds the Gnome Race Ticket when the gnomes win gets a gnome prize box.

faq.q: Who can take part in this wager?
faq.answer: The wager belongs to neither faction. Alliance and Horde travelers stand on equal footing.

faq.q: What happens if the goblins win instead?
faq.answer: If the goblins win, the goblin ticket matters. That result is called Goblins Win!, the counterpart to this one.
